processing.title: 1. Order Processing and Delivery Timeframes
processing.p1: Delivery time depends on product availability, order size, delivery location, and the selected shipping method.
processing.p2: Orders are usually processed and delivered within 3-5 business days after order confirmation.
processing.p3: If the selected size or color is unavailable, Mamaria's team will contact the customer to offer a replacement or another solution.

options.title: 2. Delivery Options
options.p1: Standard delivery through Mamaria's partner courier services. Standard delivery is free of charge.
options.p2: Express delivery is available for urgent orders, for example within approximately 1-2 hours, depending on the delivery location and courier availability at the time. Express delivery is subject to an additional charge.

fees.title: 3. Delivery Fees
fees.p1: Standard delivery is free of charge.
fees.p2: The express delivery fee is calculated based on the delivery address, area, and distance and is confirmed with the customer in advance.

receipt.title: 4. Delivery Details and Receipt of the Order
receipt.p1: The customer is responsible for providing the correct recipient name, phone number, and delivery address. Mamaria is not responsible for delays caused by incorrect or incomplete information.
receipt.p2: When receiving the order, customers should check the packaging, item quantity, size, and product type.
receipt.p3: If an incorrect or damaged item is found, please contact Mamaria as soon as possible.

delays.title: 5. Possible Delays
delays.p1: Despite our efforts, delivery may be delayed because of weather conditions, transportation issues, holiday demand, an inaccessible address, or other circumstances related to the courier service. Mamaria will notify the customer of a known delay.

important.title: Important
important.p1: Delivery timeframes are calculated in business days. Weekends and public holidays may extend the delivery period.
